title: Max Protection III
description: Caps the max level of Protection to Protection III
body:
## Max Protection III
Cap the Protection enchantment at level 3. 

This makes it impossible to obtain Protection IV in survival.

![Trying to enchant a helmet with Protection IV using /enchant](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f545f58643de0f71b11d2898ff95822da03fbb1b.png)


<details>
<summary>Note</summary>

_If you apply this datapack after Protection IV was put on a piece of armor, that piece will keep its level of protection._

</details>
<details>
<summary>Installation</summary>
  
### Server Installation (Datapack)
  
1. Go in the main server file
  
2. Open _world_ -> _datapacks_

3. Upload the datapack in the _datapacks_ folder

### World Installation (Datapack)

1. Press Win + R and enter %appdata%

2. Open _.minecraft_ -> _saves_ -> _<world name>_ -> datapacks

3. Upload the datapack in the _datapacks_ folder

(Note that if you are using a launcher like Modrinth App or Prism Launcher, you'll need to go on your instance on the launcher and click on _Open Folder_.)

### Server Installation (Mod)

1. Go in the main server file

2. Open _mods_

3. Upload the mod in the _mods_ folder
</details>
